input.title: `isKeyboardOpen` is not set to `false` when blurring Note
input.body:
## Steps to Reproduce
1. Create a new thought.
2. Add a Note to that thought.
3. Dismiss the keyboard by tapping the scroll zone.

## Current Behavior
- `isKeyboardOpen` remains `true`, even though the keyboard is closed.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/589b4a5c-4c24-44ac-9f99-bcc122eca8a6

## Expected Behavior
- `isKeyboardOpen` should be set to `false`.
